notes.title: FEVER: Fight The FEVER - DEMO RELEASED!
notes.content:
Unsure if FEVER: Fight The FEVER is the game for you? 
Well, you're in luck! Our FEVER DEMO will give you the opportunity to try the entire first level, complete with first boss encounter (The Inexplicable "BLOBBY"); then you will be thrust into endless mode to continue battling GERMS to your heart's content.

Not enough for you??? The full version of FEVER: Fight The FEVER boasts more bosses, levels, and enemies with different challenges to uproot your strategy.

Tired of YOUR biology course? TRY OURS!!!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1418610/FEVER_FIGHT_THE_FEVER/

notes.title: FEVER: Fight The FEVER - 40% OFF Launch Sale!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=X4sVw9d4-zo;full][/previewyoutube]
We here at Zin Games LLC are proud to announce that FEVER: Fight The FEVER has finally been released on STEAM! 

After the long and grueling process of getting our first game ready and released, we have finally accomplished our initial goal. We are so excited we are offering a one-week launch discount for our customers who want to get ahead of the crowd and help spread the word.

FEVER is an old-school arcade style game that mixes classic gaming elements with more modern mechanics, plus a dash of chaos and a whole heap of unique innovations. Sick of the same'ol healthbars? Just wait until you see what we did with ours!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=X4sVw9d4-zo
But it doesn't stop there. We have plenty of plans for future updates so keep an eye out! 

~Zincerely,
Zinlanthor
